answer: An AI-agent sensing economy can resist Sybil attacks via infrared plume attestation. Each node binds its key to a hardware anchor driving a thermal emitter that vents a timed warm-air burst. A patrolling drone captures nadir frames and checks the drifting plume against local wind telemetry and spacing rules. Because co-located vents merge into one trace, attackers need separate powered heaters on spaced sites per identity. Yet dense fog blocks nadir sightlines and stalls verification.
